title: Microsoft Edge: v. 149 - Unifying Copilot Chat policy controls
description: The Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policy is becoming the standard for configuring Copilot Chat. Extension and sidebar policies will no longer affect the appearance or functionality of Copilot Chat.
